parsed.explanation: The write-up explicitly leaves Part B open. Pigeonhole supplies a small {-1,0,1}-signed sum, but the text neither proves the ledger’s mirrored-cut/overlay construction nor gives another all-n method converting that sum into a legal Xiang reply using at most n cuts. It even identifies this as a “Realizability gap” and says the alternative candidate “needs verification & proof.” Closing the gap requires a substantive universal construction and proof, so the missing work is lemma-sized.
